mutations.name: F1 a delivered frame confirms the task without the handoff receipt
mutations.expectRed: a delivered frame from a relay with no handoff receipt seals the task and reports it once

mutations.name: F2 Stop leaves a claimed task awaiting its verdict
mutations.expectRed: Stop before the verdict seals the claimed task; the late receipt leaves it sealed, reported once

mutations.name: F3 SessionEnd leaves a claimed task awaiting its verdict
mutations.expectRed: SessionEnd before the verdict seals the claimed task; the late receipt leaves it sealed, reported once

mutations.name: F4 a new session leaves the old session's task awaiting its verdict
mutations.expectRed: SessionStart before the verdict seals the claimed task; the late receipt leaves it sealed, reported once

mutations.name: F5 every extra rides the frame, whether it fits beside the task or not
mutations.find: for (const x of extras) if (x && join([...kept, x, peek.text]).length <= HOOK_CONTEXT_CHARS) kept.push(x);
mutations.replace: for (const x of extras) if (x) kept.push(x);
